title: “You Sexy Thing” by Hot Chocolate
text: "You Sexy Thing" is a song by the British soul band Hot Chocolate. It was written by lead singer Errol Brown and bass guitarist Tony Wilson and was produced by Mickie Most.

title: “Love Hurts” by Nazareth
text: "Love Hurts" is a song written and composed by the American songwriter Boudleaux Bryant. First recorded by The Everly Brothers in July 1960, the song is best known in two hit versions by UK artists: by the Scottish hard rock band Nazareth for their 1975 LP Hair of the Dog and by the English singer-songwriter Jim Capaldi in 1975.

title: “Get Up and Boogie” by Silver Convention
text: "Get Up and Boogie" is a song by German disco act Silver Convention from their 1976 second album of the same name. The song was written and composed by Sylvester Levay and Stephan Prager, and produced by Prager.
